title: Camdl IR
description: Stochastic compartmental model IR schema v0.6

time_unit.description: Time axis unit: days/weeks/months/years (and per_* aliases).

origin.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) mapped to internal t=0; the I/O calendar anchor (2026-05-22 calendar-time).

origin_rata_die.description: Compiler-derived proleptic-Gregorian day number of `origin`; the runtime reads this instead of re-parsing the origin string.

per_eval_bindings.comment: gh#272 LICM: param/table-only loop-invariant bindings, topologically ordered. Produced by the loop-invariant-code-motion pass (post-autodiff; on by default, CAMDL_NO_LICM disables); omitted when empty (a non-hoisting model). Same shape as `bindings`, but bodies may be param-carrying and are cached once per theta-stable scope rather than per step.

identity_tracked_compartments.description: Compartments whose individuals carry tracked IDs (individual-sampling layer). Forward-reachable closure from `#[lineage]` event destinations and parent pools. Absent/empty when no `#[lineage]` annotations exist.

quantities.comment: Generated quantities (proposal 2026-06-25): named, non-scored reductions of simulation output — the non-scored twin of an observation. Reporting-only, fully expanded (one leaf per stratum cell). Omitted when empty.

contrasts.comment: Counterfactual contrasts (proposal 2026-06-25): named differences of two run-rooted operands (cases averted). Reporting-only and non-identity (excluded from run_id, like quantities). Omitted when empty.

scenarios.comment: Named presets (the `scenarios {}` block). Omitted when empty.

oneOf.comment: gh#272 LICM: reference to a model-level per_eval_binding by name. Param/table-only loop-invariant; cached once per theta-stable scope. Produced by the LICM pass (post-autodiff; on by default, CAMDL_NO_LICM disables); absent only when LICM is disabled or nothing hoists.

Per-observation auxiliary data column referenced by name in a likelihood (e.g. binomial `n = tested`). Resolved by the Rust binder against the bound aux columns of the enclosing observation stream; evaluates per observation. Only valid inside a likelihood argument expression (2026-06-10 observation data-entry §3, §6.1).

gh#616: an UNRESOLVED observation anchor (± a compile-folded constant offset). Emitted only into a `piecewise` forcing's `breakpoints` list — the DSL interception is scoped to that key — and substituted for a `const` by the runtime resolver before compilation; `CompiledModel::new` refuses a model that still carries one, so it never reaches an evaluator.

lineage.description: Lineage (individual-sampling) annotation for `#[lineage]` transitions. Absent for ordinary transitions.

parent_pool_weights.description: Linear decomposition of the rate over parent pools: (compartment, per-pool weight expression) pairs. For `beta*S*I/N` with parent I this is [["I", <beta*S/N>]].

lag.description: Optional gh#314 evaluation-time shift: the forcing is evaluated at t − lag instead of t. A duration expression in the model's time_unit (a literal like 10 'days, or a parameter reference). Absent ⇒ no shift (identity).

data_source.description: Compile-time provenance for a forcing declared `data = "path"`. Absent for every other forcing (and for the `table =` / inline `times`/`values` forms of `interpolated`) — it appends only when present, so a model with no file-backed forcing is byte-identical to its pre-0.33 form.

The external data file a forcing's knots were read from at compile time. The knots are inlined into the IR, so the runtime never opens this file — the record exists so a completed run can name the input it compiled against. NOT run identity: the file's CONTENT already re-keys through the inlined values, so folding the hash in as well would re-key on byte edits that change no value, and a path change must not re-key at all.

path.description: The path AS WRITTEN in the model (relative to the .camdl file), not the resolved absolute one, so it stays portable and comparable across machines and checkouts.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's raw bytes — reproducible with `shasum -a 256 <path>` from the model's directory.

beta.comment: Beta likelihood for a continuous proportion x ∈ (0,1). Mean-linked: shape parameters alpha = mean·concentration, beta = (1−mean)·concentration are formed in the runtime scorer/sampler.

zero_inflated_neg_binomial.comment: Zero-inflated NegBinomial: structural-zero mass `pi` mixed with NegBinomial(mean, dispersion). P(Y=0) = pi + (1-pi)*f(0); P(Y=k>0) = (1-pi)*f(k). All three arguments are differentiable and carry the diffable shape, as the sibling likelihood arguments do.

prior_spec.comment: Prior on an estimated parameter (gh#191). Exactly one of: flat, a single-level dist, or a hierarchical prior.

param_value.comment: Tagged union (gh#191): a parameter is a Fixed constant, an Estimated parameter (inference config lives here), or Required (supplied at runtime).

initial_conditions.description: One spec per compartment, keyed by expanded compartment name, in declaration order. Both sides preserve that order (OCaml association list, Rust IndexMap) and it is part of the model's identity. The runtime evaluates entries in DEPENDENCY order, so a spec may read another compartment's initial value; a reference cycle is rejected (E515).

diffable.description: A differentiable likelihood/law argument: the expression paired with its per-parameter classified gradient from the OCaml autodiff pass. `grad` is omitted when every derivative is a genuine zero. The `likelihood` argument positions above carry this same shape.

proj_grad.description: d(arg)/d(projected); absent for an initial-state law, which has no projection

init_count_law.description: A law an INTEGER compartment's initial count is drawn from. The argument records are the observation ones, but NOT the observation `likelihood` variant set: `bernoulli`, `beta` and `beta_binomial` describe a MEASUREMENT of a compartment, not the compartment itself, and are not admissible here.

binomial.description: `n` must be theta-independent and carries no gradient, so it is a bare expr.

neg_binomial.description: NB2: Var = mean + mean^2/dispersion. Contains Poisson as dispersion -> infinity.

init_real_law.description: A law a REAL compartment's initial value is drawn from. Two law sets rather than one, so the compartment's kind selects the admissible one.

init_spec.description: What one compartment's initial value is: COMPUTED from an expression, or DRAWN from a law.

deterministic.description: `S = N0 - I`: an expression over constants, parameters and other compartments' initial values.

count.description: `I ~ poisson(rate = I0)` on an integer compartment.

real.description: `V ~ normal(mean = v0, sd = s)` on a real compartment.

t_end_anchor.comment: gh#616: an observation-anchored horizon (`simulate { to = last_obs + 4 'weeks }`). PRESENT means the horizon is UNRESOLVED: `t_end` then carries NaN so every equality-based horizon guard fails closed, and the runtime resolver substitutes the resolved time into `t_end` and removes this key. A model that still carries it is refused at CompiledModel::new. Omitted for a literal horizon.

preset.comment: A named scenario: a parameter set (plus enable/disable/scale/compose) and optionally its own horizon. Serialized under the model's `scenarios` key.

t_end_anchor.comment: gh#616: the preset's own anchored horizon; same unresolved-marker contract as simulation_config's.

anchored_time.comment: gh#616: an observation anchor plus a constant offset ALREADY FOLDED to model time units by the compiler. The anchor's value is resolved per run from the run's bound observation streams (last_obs = max observation time, first_obs = min), so only it is data-dependent. Canonical encoding: a zero offset is the bare string; a non-zero offset is the object form. Both spellings decode.

dimension.comment: Resolved dimension of the reduced value as [P exponent, T exponent] (counterfactual-contrasts proposal #5). Computed by dimcheck and stored so the contrast reducer can check operand-dimension agreement without re-deriving. Omitted when undetermined.

contrast.comment: A named difference of two run-rooted operands — the cases-averted object (proposal 2026-06-25). No window: the counterfactual fork is derived in the reducer (the last saved snapshot before the toggled intervention's fire time) and the result is shaped over [fork, run-end].

contrast_expr.comment: Arithmetic over run-rooted operands. Externally-tagged single-key objects.

oneOf.comment: v1.1: observations.<stream> — reduces the simulated observation series (y_sim).

time_anchor.comment: When a `value_at` reads its series: a constant time expression, or an observation anchor (gh#616 generalized the bare `"last_obs"` string to the full `anchored_time`, which still emits that exact string at a zero offset). Discriminated by shape — the constant arm always carries a `time` key, the anchor arm never does.
